acceptanceCriteria: A definition-shaped line that the parser does not accept gets a diagnostic naming the accepted form
A test covers this exact shape
body: The tests-reliability lane (2026-10-21) wrote SNR-V0-030 as "- `SNR-V0-030` (V1-xxxx): ...". requirement-definitions-check did not recognise it as a definition and gave no diagnostic. The lane found out only from a later gate and rewrote the line in the accepted clause form. This is the same class of silent near-miss as V1-2160 (acceptance prefix), but in the definition parser.
